questions.answer: A computer network is a collection of interconnected devices that communicate and share resources.

questions.answer: == compares values, whereas is compares object identities.

questions.answer: A mutex is a synchronization mechanism that allows only one thread to access a critical section at a time.

questions.answer: Method overloading allows multiple methods with the same name but different parameter lists in the same class.

questions.question: What is a B+ Tree?
questions.answer: A B+ Tree is a variation of the B-Tree where all records are stored at the leaf level and leaf nodes are linked together.
